Kit summary

Tidal Surge StrikeActive
Deals 400% ATK DMG to a single enemy. If the target has [Loong's Wrath], inflicts [Feebleness II] on it for 2 turns.
Relentless TorrentActive
Deals 2 stages of DMG to all enemies. 1st stage: 100% ATK DMG and removes [Block Debuff]. 2nd stage: 200% ATK DMG and inflicts 1 layer of [Tide Decay]; if the target already has [Tide Decay], inflicts 1 layer of [Loong's Wrath] for 2 turns instead.
Abyssal Tide Relic Lv.1Casts Relentless Torrent once (max once before her action) when the ally or enemy with the highest initial SPD ends their turn, or when [Loong's Wrath] layers on enemies decrease. Torrent deals 20% increased DMG to enemies above 50% HP and its 1st stage ignores [Shield].
Majestic Tide MarkPassive
At battle start, if she has the highest initial ATK among allies, she is immune to control effects and Turn Meter reduction. When [Loong's Wrath] layers on enemies change, gains 1 layer of [Vast Waves] (+2% ATK, +4.0% Piercing, max 25 layers). At max layers, Vortex of Oblivion DMG +30% and she gains 20% Turn Meter when other allies' turns end.
Abyssal Tide Relic Lv.2When an enemy increases her Skill CD, resets all her Skill CDs and gains 20% Turn Meter (once before each action). Gains 10 layers of [Vast Waves] when an ally inflicts [Loong's Wrath] on a Boss. At max [Vast Waves], reduces CD of Relentless Torrent and Vortex of Oblivion by 1 turn at turn start. When an ally inflicts [Loong's Wrath], she inflicts 1 layer of [Raging Tide] on them (+20% DMG dealt, -20% DMG taken, max 2). Each ally with [Raging Tide] gives her +20% Skill DMG and +20% Crit DMG. Each [Direct DMG] ally gives +10% DMG to Bosses.
Vortex of OblivionActive
Grants all allies 1 layer of [Tidal Shelter] (non-Crit DMG taken reduced to 1) for 1 turn and inflicts 1 layer of [Tide Decay] (-10% Tenacity, +10% Skill DMG taken, max 4) on all enemies. Then deals 600% ATK DMG to all enemies with 100% Crit Rate, ignoring DMG Immunity and [Shield].
Abyssal Tide Relic Lv.3With 3+ [Loong's Wrath] allies at battle start: grants allies [Vast Waves Shelter] (Crit DMG taken becomes 1) for 1 turn; when an enemy loses [DMG Immunity], her next DMG +10%, and after 5 such losses she casts Vortex once and re-grants the Shelter. With 5 such allies: also grants [Tidal Shelter]; once per enemy, casts Vortex when an enemy at turn start is below 50% HP; on Boss hit inflicts [Loong's Wrath] and [Stun] 2 turns; gains 5% Mastery and 5% Max HP per non-Boss unit and converts 100% Mastery to Crit DMG (capped at 10% of initial Crit DMG); removes up to 3 [Loong's Wrath] layers, dealing 10% target Max HP Skill DMG per layer (capped at 1400% ATK vs Bosses, 400% vs non-Bosses; 100% Crit Rate, ignores DMG Immunity and Shield).
Abyssal Tide Relic (Exclusive) levels are shown under each skill they change.

The Traveler's Diary
Main statATK Rate

At the beginning of the owner's turn, grants one of the Travelogue Pages randomly to all allies:

1. Increases all allies' ATK by 9% of the owner's initial ATK.

2. Increases all allies' Crit DMG by 27%.

3. Increases all allies' Skill DMG by 9%.

Only 1 layer of Travelogue Page can be owned at the same time and all allies share the same effect. The effects mentioned above will be removed once the owner dies.
